summary: Backend-only testing for Elaya (FastAPI + MongoDB). Wrote pytest suite covering health, auth, RBAC, products, owner CRUD, orders + status pipeline, admin overview & user/shop toggle, and favorites. 27/27 tests passing against public URL https://elaya-flowers-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Seeded data present (4 users, 2 shops, ~14 products) and working. No backend bugs found for the requested scope. Two initial test-side issues (email lowercasing, xdist parallel ordering) were fixed inside the tests, not the app.

minor.issue: new_status is accepted as a raw query string with no whitelist validation — passing arbitrary values (e.g. 'foo') would be persisted. Consider Literal['active','disabled'].
HTTPException(403) is raised without a detail message for cross-customer / cross-owner access. Works, but a message helps clients.
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env is a placeholder ('change-me-in-production-2026'). Fine for preview, must be rotated for prod.

action_items: Optional: constrain admin status endpoints (users/shops) with a Literal enum to reject invalid status values.
Optional: rotate JWT_SECRET before any production deployment.
Optional: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan handlers when convenient (not blocking).
Note: frontend/.env exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — ensure frontend reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL when frontend testing begins.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~420-line file — acceptable now, but split into routers (auth/products/orders/admin) once features grow past ~700 lines.
All endpoints correctly strip MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0}; register/register-owner insert paths also pop _id — good.
RBAC via require() dependency is clean and consistently applied.
Order status update endpoint does not enforce a forward-only state machine — an owner can move an order from 'completed' back to 'pending'. Consider validating transitions.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_* users, products, and orders via the API. No manual DB seeding required — startup seed() populates admin/customer/2 owners/2 shops/~14 products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable at https://elaya-flowers-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest -v -n 0 (xdist parallel is enabled by default in pytest.ini via loadscope — pass -n 0 for deterministic order because TestOrders and TestAdmin share state through pytest attribute globals). Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md are correct. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var. When testing frontend, verify role-based redirect after login (customer→marketplace, flower_owner→owner dashboard, admin→admin dashboard) and Shopee-style bottom sheet login UI.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bugs. Two test failures on the first run were caused by (1) server lowercasing emails on register/login (correct behaviour) vs the test asserting original casing, and (2) pytest-xdist LoadScopeScheduling running TestAdmin on a different worker than TestOrders, so the completed_orders>=1 assertion race-conditioned. Both were fixed in the test file.
